content.user_title: Create Clear Changelogs from Git History
content.value_statement: Technical commit histories are difficult for customers to understand. This skill organizes changes and rewrites them as clear, audience-focused release notes.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Git commits for a requested date, tag, or release range.
Groups changes into features, improvements, fixes, breaking changes, and security updates.
Rewrites technical commit messages in clear customer language.
Filters internal changes such as refactoring and test updates.
Applies guidance from a repository CHANGELOG_STYLE.md file.
Formats content for changelogs, release notes, app stores, and product updates.
limitations: Requires access to the repository and its Git history.
Output quality depends on the detail and accuracy of commit messages.
Cannot infer product impact that is absent from commits and repository context.
Generated notes require review before public distribution.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Release Notes
use_cases.description: Turn commits since the previous version into customer-facing notes grouped by change type.

use_cases.title: Publish GitHub Releases
use_cases.description: Summarize changes between tags for a concise GitHub release description.

use_cases.title: Compile Weekly Updates
use_cases.description: Convert one week of development activity into a readable internal or external update.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Changelog
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a customer-friendly changelog from commits since the last release. Group related changes and exclude internal maintenance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after a release cycle with clear commit messages.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Date Range
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate release notes for commits between [start date] and [end date]. Separate features, improvements, fixes, and breaking changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for weekly, monthly, or milestone updates.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Version Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create release notes for version [version] from commits since [previous tag]. Explain user impact and highlight required migration steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when publishing a tagged software release.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Custom Editorial Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze commits from [range] and follow CHANGELOG_STYLE.md. Merge duplicate changes, omit internal work, and flag uncertain claims for review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced releases with established editorial standards.

output_examples.input: Create release notes for the past week from commits about team workspaces, faster synchronization, and an image upload fix.
output_examples.output: New Features: Team workspaces help members organize projects separately. Improvements: Files synchronize faster across devices. Fixes: Large images now upload correctly.

output_examples.input: Summarize changes between versions 2.4.0 and 2.5.0 for customers.
output_examples.output: Version 2.5.0 adds keyboard shortcuts, expands search to file contents, and corrects notification badge counts.

output_examples.input: Prepare an app store update from commits that improve search and fix scheduled post timezones.
output_examples.output: Search now includes file contents, and scheduled posts display the correct time across timezones.

best_practices: Specify a precise date, tag, or release range.
Provide audience and style guidance before generation.
Verify user impact, version details, and security claims before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated notes without checking them against the release.
Do not include internal refactoring unless it changes user experience.
Do not claim performance or security improvements without supporting evidence.

faq.question: What repository access does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs access to the project repository and the Git history for the requested range.

faq.question: Can it generate notes between Git tags?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the starting and ending tags or identify the target version and previous release.

faq.question: Can it follow our writing style?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide direct style instructions or a repository CHANGELOG_STYLE.md file.

faq.question: Does it remove internal development noise?
faq.answer: Yes. It can omit tests, refactoring, and maintenance work that has no customer impact.

faq.question: Can it create app store update text?
faq.answer: Yes. State the audience and desired length so the result matches the store format.

faq.question: Should generated changelogs be reviewed?
faq.answer: Yes. Confirm accuracy, customer impact, version numbers, and any migration or security statements before publication.
